defects_fixed.before: Operation filters were not consistently routed and the schema allowed behavior whose names implied side effects.
defects_fixed.after: A strict no-additional-properties schema exposes four read-only operations, routes optional synthetic identifiers, and preserves safe legacy aliases.

defects_fixed.before: The agent could imply eligibility, authorization, clinical interpretation, outreach, scheduling, or record mutation beyond evidence.
defects_fixed.after: Every route uses synthetic-only evidence, explicit uncertainty, no side effects, and a qualified human review gate.

claim_audit.claim: Pull payer-specific requirements and match them with EHR data
claim_audit.implementation: Crosswalks fictional policy checklist items to synthetic evidence; authoritative policy and EHR review remain human tasks.

claim_audit.claim: Compile the full clinical evidence packet needed for medical review
claim_audit.implementation: Drafts an inventory; completeness and minimum necessity require utilization review.

claim_audit.claim: Submit requests directly to payer portals and send real-time updates
claim_audit.implementation: No submission, portal action, notification, scheduling, or record mutation occurs.

claim_audit.claim: Flag cases requiring additional documentation and prepare appeal materials proactively
claim_audit.implementation: Surfaces missing source fields and drafts a reconsideration outline without filing or recommending an appeal.

claim_policy: Catalog value claims are qualitative. Exact fields and identifiers are retained only as clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
